name: get_light_status
description: Get whether each indicator light is currently on or off.

name: get_clock_time
description: Get the current time shown on the clock.

name: read_logs
description: Show, list or view the saved log entries of one log column, or of all columns. These are the manual logs, not the terminal.

column.description: Which log column, or all of them.

name: get_terminal_history
description: Show the history of commands typed in the terminal. Not the log entries.

name: toggle_light
description: Turn one indicator light on or off.

state.description: true to turn the light on, false to turn it off.

name: set_yellow_timing
description: Set the range of the yellow light's automatic random toggle interval, in milliseconds.

minMs.description: Minimum interval in milliseconds, at least 1000.

maxMs.description: Maximum interval in milliseconds, at most 60000.

name: create_log_entry
description: Add a NEW entry to the blue, yellow or red log column.

column.description: Which log column: blue, yellow or red.

time.description: Time of the new entry, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit for the current time.

left.description: Blue column only: left half on (true) or off (false).

right.description: Blue column only: right half on (true) or off (false).

on.description: Yellow column only: light on (true) or off (false).

name: update_log_entry
description: Change an EXISTING log entry. The entry is found by the time it was logged.

column.description: Which log column: blue, yellow or red.

time.description: The time of the existing entry to change, 24-hour HH:MM.

newTime.description: A new time for the entry, 24-hour HH:MM. Only when the time itself changes.

left.description: Blue column only: left half on (true) or off (false).

right.description: Blue column only: right half on (true) or off (false).

on.description: Yellow column only: light on (true) or off (false).

name: delete_log_entry
description: Delete one log entry. The entry is found by the time it was logged.

column.description: Which log column: blue, yellow or red.

time.description: The time of the entry to delete, 24-hour HH:MM.

name: clear_logs
description: Delete ALL log entries in one column. Destructive.

name: export_logs
description: Export all log data as JSON or CSV.
